```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(plotly);library(gt)
source("R/helper_functions.R")
source("R/plotting_functions.R")
load_data(); cca<-params$cca
```

```{r include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
le_2024 <- lifeexp %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca,
    Year == 2024
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(le)

le_2024 <- round(le_2024[1], 1)

intro <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Intro)

racedemo <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Race_Ethnicity_Description)

sexdemo <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Sex_Description)

agedemo <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Age_Description)

lenarrative <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca) %>%
      dplyr::pull(lenarrative)

lcodnarrative <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca) %>%
      dplyr::pull(lcodnarrative)

lcodovertime <- narratives %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CCA == cca) %>%
      dplyr::pull(lcodovertime)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", message=FALSE, fig.align="left", results='hide', warning=FALSE}

chicago_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
cca_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

chi <- plot_chicago_map(cca)

chi <- chi +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

cca_map <- plot_cca_zoom(cca)

  ggsave(
    filename = chicago_file,
    plot = chi,
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = cca_file,
    plot = cca_map,
    width = 5,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300)
```

<div style="font-size:20px; color: #000000;">

The first map displayed above shows the City of Chicago with Chicago Community Area life expectancy measures from 2024. `r cca` is outlined in red. To the right of the map of Chicago, a magnified map of `r cca` is shown.

The life expectancy, or average number of years a person may expect to live, for `r cca` was `r le_2024` in 2024 based on CHA methodology. Life expectancy is a measure commonly used to understand the general health of communities. When looking at a hyperlocal level in Chicago, clear disparities exist which may be explained by examining what health outcomes and conditions are exacerbating this gap.
</div>

<!-- Links for CHA related topic pages -->

<div style="font-size: 20px; color: #000000;">
The Chicago Health Atlas [Leading Cause of Death](https://chicagohealthatlas.org/cod) topic page presents Vital Statistics data from the Illinois Department of Public Health (IDPH) by total population and race/ethnicity. The [Life Expectancy](https://chicagohealthatlas.org/life-expectancy) topic page presents life expectancy data calculated from the Illinois Department of Public Health's 2022-2023 death certificate data as well as the U.S. Census Bureau's 2020 decennial census data.
</div>
